title: Confirmed US human H5 bird flu cases by exposure source

source.name: A(H5) Bird Flu: Current Situation
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: Of 70 total confirmed/probable US human H5 cases reported since April 2024, 41 were linked to exposure to sick dairy cows, 26 to exposure to infected poultry, and 3 had an undetermined source (omitted here as it isn't one of the two named exposure routes). One case was hospitalized and died; 94% of cases were mild.
